brief.audience: Independent creators and founders directing multi-format creative production
brief.reader_job: Decide which Astra-enabled creator workflows to commission and how to verify that the tools produced usable, editable work.
brief.thesis: Evaluate Astra at the creative handoff: an accepted, editable artifact that preserves the source idea and brand, with measured repair cost.
brief.original_delta: A cross-vendor capability/access/acceptance matrix, one original multi-format creator commission, and a project-level evaluation scorecard with a recovery test.
secondary_questions: What changes across ChatGPT, Work and Codex?
Can Astra use Adobe, Canva and HeyGen?
How should creator tool calls be evaluated?
brief.strongest_objection: A vendor demonstration and a documented integration do not establish the success rate of a creator's own multi-tool workflow.
brief.publication_authority: Parent editor handles repository, preview and publication evidence. This worker produces draft sources only.
brief.freshness: Recheck vendor capabilities and access rules at publication, on any plugin/model release, or after 30 days.

sources.title: Adobe Integration for ChatGPT
sources.paraphrase: The current Adobe plugin exposes supported creative and document capabilities across ChatGPT, Work and Codex on web and desktop. The page describes video cuts/resizing, image editing and document creation. Tool subsets, account requirements and eligible paid plan requirements apply. Signed-in users can continue supported saved work in Creative Cloud.
sources.rights: Link and original paraphrase only; no copied logos or media.
sources.reliability_notes: This live page has broader capabilities than Adobe's December 2025 launch announcement, which was not used for current feature claims.

sources.title: Actions you can take in AI assistants connected to Canva MCP
sources.paraphrase: Canva documents design search, design generation, export, brand template search, dataset schema lookup and template autofill through MCP. The page notes tool visibility varies by client/mode.
sources.rights: Link and original paraphrase only; no copied templates or media.

sources.title: Connect AI assistants to Canva with the AI Connector
sources.paraphrase: Canva lists Pro, Teams, Business and Nonprofit as eligible AI Connector plans and documents account and administrator access requirements.

sources.title: Using ChatGPT to Create Designs and Search Content
relevant_sections: Limitations of Canva features in ChatGPT
sources.paraphrase: This generic page says brand features and export must be done in Canva, differing from MCP-specific documentation. It also lists regional exclusions. Do not universalize these restrictions or imply all clients expose identical tools.
sources.reliability_notes: Conflicts with MCP-specific capability descriptions; article directs readers to verify the actual connected surface.

sources.title: HeyGen ChatGPT App — AI Video from Any Prompt
sources.paraphrase: HeyGen documents conversation-driven video creation and revision using avatars, motion graphics, b-roll and narration. Generation needs a HeyGen account and uses its credits. Advanced editing, branding and collaboration remain in HeyGen's own platform.
sources.rights: Link and original paraphrase only; no copied video or avatar media.

sources.title: Building a shareable site
relevant_sections: Turn an idea into a website
sources.paraphrase: Sites can build and host web experiences from ChatGPT Work, with support for stored information and files. It is in public beta, and availability and sharing choices depend on account/workspace settings.

sources.title: Getting started with ChatGPT Work
sources.paraphrase: Chat and Work can both use plugins. OpenAI recommends Chat for questions/quick edits and Work for tasks requiring several steps or app context and a reviewable finished result.

claims.text: OpenAI describes stronger computer use, visual judgment and template adherence in the Astra release.
claims.freshness: At publication and on model update
claims.public_wording: OpenAI's September 3 release describes stronger computer use, visual judgment, and template adherence.

claims.text: The main creator evaluation unit should be an accepted editable artifact and the labor/cost needed to obtain it.
claims.public_wording: My recommendation: commission one complete creative project and inspect every deliverable. Keep the source files. Measure the time you spend correcting the result.

claims.text: Both Chat and Work can use plugins; Work is suited to multi-step production tasks.
claims.public_wording: Both Chat and Work can use plugins. OpenAI positions Chat for questions and quick edits, and Work for tasks involving several steps, app context, and a result to review.

claims.text: OpenAI's game demonstration combines concept references, implementation and browser testing under ongoing human gameplay review.
claims.public_wording: In Thomas Ricouard's Void Explorer project, concept images became references for a playable game built in Codex. The implementation included browser tests and inspectable game state, while Ricouard continued playing and judging the experience.

claims.text: OpenAI's visualization demonstration develops editable Blender work into stills, camera sequences and an Unreal walkthrough, with translation/visual review constraints.
claims.public_wording: His architectural visualization project began with an editable Blender scene and developed into stills, a camera tour, and an Unreal Engine walkthrough. Materials needed translation between rendering systems, and some behavior was approximated.

claims.text: Adobe documents creative tool subsets across ChatGPT, Work and Codex, with account/plan conditions and supported Creative Cloud handoff.
claims.public_wording: Supported tools across ChatGPT, Work, and Codex. Guest access covers a subset; accounts and eligible paid plans unlock additional capabilities.

claims.text: Canva's MCP documentation lists template autofill/export and plan/permission gates; its generic ChatGPT page describes different limitations.
claims.public_wording: MCP documentation lists template autofill and export. AI Connector access has plan and permission requirements.

claims.text: HeyGen documents ChatGPT video generation through a connected account and credits; advanced editing/branding remains in the main platform.
claims.public_wording: Conversation-driven video generation uses a HeyGen account and credits. Advanced editing and branding use HeyGen's main platform.

claims.text: Sites is in public beta, with availability and sharing dependent on the account/workspace.
claims.public_wording: ChatGPT Work can build and host a site. Sites is in public beta; availability and sharing depend on account and workspace settings.
